statements.status_notes: Debian fixed this for trixie in libevent 2.1.13-stable-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6493-1), which ships the upstream 2.1.13-stable point release, and the DHI build of that Debian version carries the fix. Upstream commit https://github.com/libevent/libevent/commit/5e3c6ebe342b34c5a9bcf48e9a32ad6708b9c416 makes evtag_unmarshal_header reject a decoded payload length above INT_MAX. Checked by inspecting the DHI Debian packages on amd64 and arm64 with their debug symbols. The disassembly of evtag_unmarshal_header in the libevent-2.1 and libevent-extra-2.1 shared libraries contains the added sign test on the decoded length (a sign-bit branch on amd64 and a bit-31 branch on arm64) that builds without the fix lack. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-63384 and https://github.com/libevent/libevent/security/advisories/GHSA-45c6-qx49-89m8.
